$comment: Sponsor bookings. One title_banner and one native_briefing are shown per category per day. A category-specific booking beats an 'all' booking. Dates are inclusive, in NEXT_PUBLIC_DISPLAY_TIMEZONE. Edit and redeploy to change. Optional 'i18n': { 'es': {...}, 'zh': {...} } overrides headline, summary, why_it_matters and cta_label per language.

sponsors.headline: Vellum Compute
sponsors.summary: Dedicated H200 & Blackwell clusters with zero egress fees for enterprise inference teams.

es.summary: Clústeres dedicados H200 y Blackwell sin cargos de salida para equipos de inferencia empresarial.

zh.summary: 为企业推理团队提供专属 H200 与 Blackwell 集群，零出口流量费。

sponsors.headline: Acme AI cuts month-end close from ten days to two
sponsors.summary: Acme AI's finance agents reconcile ledgers, flag anomalies and draft variance notes automatically. Controllers at 400+ mid-market companies now review exceptions instead of spreadsheets.
sponsors.why_it_matters: Finance teams are reclaiming a week every month for analysis rather than data entry.

es.headline: Acme AI reduce el cierre contable de diez días a dos
es.summary: Los agentes financieros de Acme AI concilian cuentas, detectan anomalías y redactan notas de variación automáticamente. Más de 400 empresas medianas ya solo revisan las excepciones.
es.why_it_matters: Los equipos financieros recuperan una semana al mes para análisis en lugar de captura de datos.

zh.headline: Acme AI 将月末结账从十天缩短至两天
zh.summary: Acme AI 的财务智能体可自动对账、标记异常并起草差异说明。400 多家中型企业的财务主管如今只需审核例外情况。
zh.why_it_matters: 财务团队每月可节省一周时间，用于分析而非录入数据。
